BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to a statewide student association; and adding anew section to chapter 28B.76 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28B.76 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The board shall recognize one nonprofit statewide studentassociation for the state's public fouryear institutions. Thisrecognition shall include the annual review and approval of the bylawsof the association. (2) Each recognized campus student government association shall beaffiliated with the statewide student association. All studentsenrolled on those campuses with recognized student governmentorganizations shall be members of the statewide student association,unless they voluntarily choose not to be. (3)(a) A statewide student association fee may be assessed upon allstudents of the state's fouryear institutions, subject to the approvalof the board. (b) Students who voluntarily choose not to be members of thestatewide student association may not be assessed the fee. p. 1 SSB 5971 (c) The assessment of the fee shall be subject to annual review andapproval by the board. The amount of the fee may not exceed onequarter of one percent of resident undergraduate tuition. (d) The fee shall be collected by the fouryear institutions anddirectly transferred at least semiannually to the statewide studentassociation. A percentage of fees collected may be retained by theinstitutions to cover administrative costs, not to exceed five percent. (4) The statewide student association shall submit an annual reportto the board and to the relevant committees of the legislature byDecember 31st of each year. The report shall also be furnished to eachaffiliated student government organization and upon request to anymember of the association. The report shall include a list of currentofficers and employees, a legislative agenda, and a current budget.The report shall also include the results of an annual audit conductedby a certified public accountant or accounting firm. The report shallbe informational in nature and is not subject to approval. (5) The statewide student association shall operate at thedirection of a board of directors. Officers of the board shallrepresent the diversity of the fouryear institutions, includingunderrepresented groups and shall be elected from the membership of theassociation. The process for election of members to the board ofdirectors and the duties encompassed in their roles shall be defined inthe bylaws of the association. (6) The statewide student association shall carry out educational,issue advocacy, and awareness activities in the interest of itsmembers. (7) The fee shall not be used or authorized to be used for anyactivity associated with local, state, or federal elections or theelection process, including but not limited to, activities associatedwith the promotion or opposition to a candidate, an election relatedissue with the intention of influencing an election, or a ballotproposition. (8) The statewide student association shall not be prevented fromlobbying government institutions in the interest of its members,including but not limited to: The legislature, the governor and thegovernor's staff, and other executive branch agencies, boards, andcommissions. SSB 5971 p. 2 (9) The board shall adopt rules as may be necessary or appropriateto implement this section.
